name: Scandiano (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Scandiano (a yellow bend on blue) beneath a brown eagle, with the mottoes PROXIMA COELO and NUNQUAM INFIDELIS on scrolls.
history: Municipal flag of Scandiano, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Scandiano arms — yellow bend on blue, crowned, with an eagle and motto scrolls PROXIMA COELO and NUNQUAM INFIDELIS
